replies.author: @staroutlaw473
replies.text: “The history is actually the opposite. The Grenadines were originally administered with Grenada. British records show that in the late 1700s Bequia and the northern Grenadines were still treated as appendages of Grenada until Britain divided the Grenadines. Around 1791 Union Island and the islands north of it were placed under Saint Vincent, while Carriacou and the southern Grenadines remained with Grenada. So Carriacou did not become Grenadian after belonging to Saint Vincent — Carriacou stayed with Grenada when the Grenadines were divided. 🇬🇩🤝🇻🇨”
